_: English - the master file. Every other language carries the same keys; a missing key falls back to English. `chrome` maps the Lithuanian hub chrome phrases (vendor planas.template.html) to this language.
name: English

app.name: Planas
app.tagline: Every test, every deadline, every new file from your Moodle in one place - and a 15-minute-a-day plan to be ready for each of them.
app.worksWith: Works with Moodle™. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Moodle Pty Ltd.
app.demo: Demo mode: sample data. Connect your own Moodle to see your courses.
app.notConnected: The local app is not running. Start it to see your own courses.
app.estimateNote: Estimates. They come from how much of the likely material fits into your minutes - not a prediction of your grade.

today.title: Today's plan
today.noPlan: No plan yet. Connect Moodle, mark which tests are in person, then build the plan.

tests.title: Tests & exams
tests.digesting: Preparing the material for the next test of this subject…
tests.preparing: Reading the course and building the study units for this test…
tests.noTopics: No material is linked to this test yet - prepare it from the mirrored course
tests.emptyUpcoming: Nothing scheduled. Add your tests by hand or let the calendar fill them in.
tests.emptyCompleted: Completed tests appear here in grey.
tests.subject: Subject

sliders.title: How much do you want to study?
sliders.forced: Raised to {n} min/day - below that the material for your target does not fit before the test.
sliders.drop: Drops by {n} step(s) from your target
sliders.noDrop: Your target is within reach at this pace
sliders.saved: Saves {m} min/day · {t} min until the last test
sliders.over: {m} min/day more than the plan needs
sliders.ideal: Everything the teacher posted fits at {n} min/day

material.title: Your material, checked
material.intro: Every file, page and video the app has seen, and what it did with it. If something is missing, it is listed here as not used - tell us.
material.newMaterial: New material since your last visit: {n} item(s)
material.addNew: Add the new material to the plan
material.adding: Fitting the new material into your topics…
material.nothingNew: Nothing new on Moodle since the last scan.

settings.title: Settings
settings.detected: Detected from your location: {lang}. You can change it.
settings.factCheckHelp: Off: the study material keeps your teacher's wording exactly. On: when a fact in the material is certainly wrong or outdated, the correct fact is used and every change is listed with its basis - your teacher may still mark by their own key.
settings.corrections: Corrections the fact checker would make
settings.shareHelp: Share anonymous, non-personal usage data (which features you use, plan sizes, errors). Never your name, e-mail, school, course files, grades or Moodle identity. Off by default; you can switch it off at any time.
settings.digestHelp: Baseline (no AI, free): headings, definitions and figures from the material. Local AI (free, private): Ollama on this computer. Cloud AI: included in the paid plan.

routes.extension: Browser extension (recommended, works with any school login)
routes.password: Username and password (sent to your school only, never stored)

settings.deleteAccount: Delete my account and all its data

report.button: Report a bug or suggest a feature
report.title: Tell us
report.text: What happened, or what you would like
report.privacy: Do not include passwords or other people's names.

legal.disclaimer: Planas helps you plan and revise. Grades depend on you, your teachers and your school; we do not guarantee any result.
legal.footer: © {year} Planas · Terms · Privacy · Works with Moodle™
